_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-05 slate (Taipei 09-06). Sixth slate of the prospective test, and the first board priced under the new board-reading rule (docs/board_reading.md): where my reading of which row carries the handicap conflicts with the US moneyline, the moneyline decides. Fourteen of the fifteen games on the US card; Athletics at Mariners is on the card but its row is not legible on the screenshots and is left out rather than guessed. One conflict: Diamondbacks at Astros, where I read the handicap on Arizona's row but the market has Houston at 0.5043 with eleven of fifteen books at or above even money and none below -- thin, but one-directional, so Houston is the favourite here and Arizona is recorded as the alternative reading. Under the old rule this near-coin-flip would have kept my reading, so the rule bites on its first day. Two other games are near even and do not conflict: Rays at Rangers sits at exactly 0.5000 with eight books a shade toward Tampa Bay and none toward Texas, which agrees with my row; Blue Jays at Royals is quoted at a 0 handicap, where laying and receiving are the same wager and the label carries no meaning. Handicaps flat at 0.950; totals flat at 0.940 except four games quoting a split, recorded per game. No first-half totals are legible on these screenshots.
